# MeedyaDL 1.11.0-alpha.25

More queue polish: expand any row for extra detail, and column headers now stay put while you scroll.

### What's new

- **Expand any queue row for extra detail.** Click the new arrow on a download row to reveal more information — the full link, save location, audio details, and more — without needing a wider window.
- **Column headers stay visible while scrolling.** On a long queue, the column labels at the top no longer scroll out of view.
- This finishes off the first round of the queue's visual refresh that's been landing across recent alpha builds (responsive columns, album art, colour-coded status, hover actions, and now this). ([details](https://github.com/MWBMPartners/MeedyaDL/issues/911))

### Notes

- This is a pre-release on the **alpha** channel — early access to work in progress. The in-app updater serves the latest stable unless you've opted into Alpha.
